themes_detail.label: Illegal pet-keeping surge
themes_detail.summary: Complaints about illegal animals kept as pets spiked to 4 THIS WEEK versus a baseline of 0.4 per week over the prior 8 weeks—a 967% increase (z-score: 7.49)—suggesting either a new enforcement push, an emerging animal hoarding situation, or concentration of unlicensed exotic pet ownership in Jamaica/Hollis/St. Albans.
evidence: 4 illegal animal complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Z-score of 7.49 indicates statistically extreme spike
No prior Reddit or news context suggesting this was predictable
reporting_angles: Are NYPD or Animal Care & Control conducting a new enforcement operation in the district?
Interview residents: are there specific addresses with hoarded or exotic animals causing public safety concerns?

themes_detail.label: Elevator outages accelerating
themes_detail.summary: Elevator complaints have spiked twice in the past 2 weeks—5 complaints THIS WEEK (471% above baseline of 0.9) and 29 last week (134% above baseline)—suggesting systematic failures in public housing or multi-family buildings, particularly urgent given the district's aging public housing stock.
evidence: 5 elevator complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.9 weekly baseline (471% spike, z-score: 5.28)
29 elevator complaints LAST WEEK vs. 12.4 weekly baseline (134% spike, z-score: 5.07)
Two consecutive weeks of sustained elevation suggests systemic issue, not isolated incident
reporting_angles: Which NYCHA buildings or multi-family complexes are most affected? Are maintenance contracts being honored?
How long are residents waiting for repairs, and how does this affect elderly or disabled residents?

themes_detail.label: Street vendor enforcement spike
themes_detail.summary: Vendor enforcement complaints jumped to 12 THIS WEEK versus a baseline of 1.4 per week—a 773% increase (z-score: 7.11)—indicating either a new city crackdown or emerging vendor clustering in Jamaica's commercial corridor that is prompting resident complaints.
evidence: 12 vendor enforcement complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.4 weekly baseline (773% spike, z-score: 7.11)
No prior news mentions or Reddit discussion of vendor issues in Jamaica/Hollis
Spike is brand-new, not a carry-over from earlier weeks
reporting_angles: Has the city launched a new vendor enforcement initiative targeting Jamaica Avenue or commercial zones?
Are street vendors experiencing harassment, or are residents complaining about quality-of-life impacts?

themes_detail.label: Building code violations escalating
themes_detail.summary: Building/Use violations spiked 2 weeks ago to 40 complaints (104% above the 8-week baseline of 19.6, z-score: 5.89), and construction/plumbing complaints jumped 210% to 43 (z-score: 5.33), together suggesting either illegal conversions, unpermitted renovations, or code enforcement activity across the district's 805 recent DOB permit filings.
evidence: 40 Building/Use complaints 2 WEEKS AGO vs. 19.6 weekly baseline (104% spike, z-score: 5.89)
43 General Construction/Plumbing complaints 2 WEEKS AGO vs. 13.9 weekly baseline (210% spike, z-score: 5.33)
805 total DOB permit filings in last 90 days (512 alterations, 149 new buildings) suggest active development and renovation pressure
reporting_angles: Are unpermitted alterations or illegal conversions (e.g., basement apartments, subdivisions) driving code violations?
Interview DOB inspectors: is the district seeing a wave of non-compliant construction tied to housing demand?

themes_detail.label: Public urination complaints spike
themes_detail.summary: Public urination complaints jumped to 3 complaints 2 weeks ago—a 700% increase from a baseline of 0.4 (z-score: 5.42)—a significant spike for this category that may reflect encampment concentration, lack of public restrooms, or broader public order deterioration in a specific neighborhood zone.
evidence: 3 urinating in public complaints 2 WEEKS AGO vs. 0.4 weekly baseline (700% spike, z-score: 5.42)
Pattern does not appear sustained (only one elevated week reported)
No corroborating Reddit or news discussion of homelessness or encampments in Jamaica/Hollis
reporting_angles: Is there an encampment or homeless concentration in a specific park or transit hub?
Does the district lack adequate public restroom access, especially near Jamaica Station?
